renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-evidence constellation-afterglow guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair and no extra adviser, partner, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one bounded verified fact and one separated blank recheck marker covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Connect them only with a visibly broken, non-deterministic starlight interval; never show a completed route, correct choice, certainty, verdict, destiny, guaranteed return or future outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Evidence tokens, trays, doors, seals, sockets, bottles, result pieces and next markers remain loose, blank, open or removable. Libra may use exactly one abstract evidence balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
